title: Chat service architecture
purpose: Explain HTTP stateless APIs versus persistent WebSocket real-time services, presence/history storage and offline push notifications.
alt: HTTP API와 웹소켓 실시간 채팅·접속 상태, 채팅 이력 및 오프라인 푸시 알림 구조
requiredChecks: Client HTTP→Load balancer→API servers is separate from bidirectional WebSocket path Client↔Real-time services.
Real-time services boundary contains Chat servers and Presence servers; KV store contains chat history and presence state.
API handles Login/profile and user data DB; API service discovery returns server endpoint without relaying every chat message.
Offline notifications go through Notification server and Push provider to Client, distinct from online WebSocket messages.
